outcome: Cytokine production profile (IL-4, IL-10, MIF, IL-6, IL-8)
cohort: The study utilized human trophoblast cell lines (BeWo cells and HTR-8/SVneo cells) and human villous explants.
finding: Biogenic silver nanoparticles (AgNp-Bio) effectively reduced *Toxoplasma gondii* replication in both human trophoblast cell models and villous explants, demonstrating a promising alternative treatment strategy.
